# Operations review

## Observations

- We hypothesise that shorter forms raise completion; we will test it by comparing completion on the old and new form over four weeks.
- The warehouse team will finish the shelf relabelling by 30 June.
- Support hours run from 08:00 to 20:00 on weekdays.
- The queue at the north gate was shorter on Friday than on Thursday.
